product_intake.title: Krastorio 2 science-tier phase-out does not apply to MIR-generated research
product_intake.source_observation: Maintainer report against the immutable 3.2.5 package. Exact local Krastorio2 2.1.2 runs its final tier-separation pass before MIR; the existing K2SO scenario currently asserts retention of five early/base science packs on research_advanced_circuit.

reproduction.evidence: Immutable 3.2.5 loaded successfully on Factorio 2.1.13 with exact Krastorio2 2.1.2 and K2SO 2.0.13. campaign-evidence.json SHA-256 CE4AC36D3BBC9174965B4FDE3537C734E76E12FDE6F3FFBB6DDE1DAA42F1605A; load-results.json SHA-256 16FFACDB85F47B95E571F37A6F24EE544ECB4A5BC63AFAD8461C32B3CC237241. The capture records 73 of 76 generated streams retaining at least one automation, logistic, chemical, or military science pack; research_advanced_circuit retains automation, logistic, chemical, production, and electromagnetic packs. Source: Krastorio2_2.1.2/prototypes/final-fixes/enforce-science-tier-separation.lua; validation/scenarios/local-2.1.json#local-2-1-krastorio-spaced-out; build/results/terminal-characterization/k2-2.1.2-attempt-02/

product_intake.title: Combined compilation plan can assign one direct effect to both a dedicated stream and a base continuation
product_intake.source_observation: A reporter supplied a 221-row mod-list with 100 enabled entries. The immutable 3.2.5 package fails to load when finalized external weapon technologies add gun-speed/tesla while MIR plans both its dedicated electric-shooting-speed stream and the weapon-shooting-speed base continuation.

reproduction.evidence: Reporter mod-list SHA-256 E5C99BD9A7C0B28F061C2D6F0F50371ACE3508A447805921183C605F56E65AC4. Immutable 3.2.5 archive SHA-256 AC81CAD1AC37F20E27A46BFAD243611DB251CACCF52E1AB4DA5D06CFDAA11ADF. Exact Factorio 2.1.13 binary SHA-256 CA89D178A82D705BD570F46CE8CCF83E50503D3C5AFDECCD77A6061FBC985084. Portal-resolved 18-archive Space Exploration plus sei-tesla-turret-2 closure lock SHA-256 69AA6C1214AE1D9E2E8B3A629A2A8AF94B81269D994799C05193B624EE582CC7; every archive matched its portal SHA-1. Dedicated userdata result SHA-256 3CA717ED4AD1664F32C99CF02E3B23146E898693D8B3E9AA6B342B7AAC73A134 and full log SHA-256 488C12075B3BA510960DEF070491505B633DDD4352E916363FAE70C18CE86B54 reproduce: CompilationPlan contains duplicate direct-effect identity: type=gun-speed;ammo_category=tesla. Source minimization shows Space Exploration 0.7.61 copies laser gun-speed effects to tesla; K2, AmmoGroup, and reporter-only unrelated mods are not required for the collision.

product_intake.stable_id_and_migration_impact: Existing generated technology IDs must remain stable. The losing combined-plan claim must be removed before graph qualification; retained operations must receive refreshed TechnologyDesign and fingerprint authority, and an emptied base continuation must be omitted without deleting the dedicated stream.
